description: secp256k1 ECDSA vectors for ic402 behaviour that Wycheproof does not pin. Built for test/secp256k1.test.mo; how each was made and checked is in the README beside this file. recover_v0 / recover_v1 are what EvmAddress.ecRecover must return for v = 0 / v = 1, and ecrecover_v27 / ecrecover_v28 what Ethereum's ecrecover (and EvmAddress.ecRecoverEvm with v = 0 / 1) returns (null = no key).

vectors.name: r + n fallback: x = r is not on the curve, R.x = r + n
vectors.ethereum: ecrecover recovers nothing for either v: it only tries x = r, which is not on the curve
vectors.noble_curves_2_4_0: verify accepts for signer; recovery bits 0 and 1 throw (x = r not on the curve); bit 2 recovers recover_v0 (the signer) and bit 3 recovers recover_v1

vectors.name: parity fallthrough: under R's own parity the recovered point is infinity
vectors.ethereum: ecrecover recovers the signer for v = 27 and nothing for v = 28 (infinity)
vectors.noble_curves_2_4_0: verify accepts for signer; recovery bit 0 recovers the signer; bit 1 throws (point at infinity)
